place.name: Mountain community
place.utility: PG&E (Lebec/the mountain community PSPS events: Mountain Enterprise 2020-09-08 https://mountainenterprise.com/story/pg-kern-opens-fp-cooling-center/ ; 23ABC "Power still out for some in Lebec, the mountain community areas due to PG&E shut offs")

risk_profile.evidence: CAZ597: {'Red Flag Warning': 19, 'Fire Weather Watch': 11} (2019-10-10→2026-10-15); PG&E de-energized Lebec Sept 8 2020 with a the mountain park cooling center opened.
San Andreas: 1857 Fort Tejon earthquake ~M7.9, ~225 mi rupture Parkfield→Wrightwood (Wikipedia "1857 Fort Tejon earthquake"). USGS: 31 M4+ within 50 km since 1970.

top5.place: 18km N of Pine Mountain Club, CA

risk_profile.evidence: CAZ336 winter products 5 yrs: WWY 30, WSW 13, WSA 10, Blizzard 1; elevation ~4,632 ft; I-5 chain controls.
High Wind Warning 14, Wind Advisory 21 in 5 yrs.
Heat products Jul/Aug; Flood Watch 16 in CAZ336; county-wide flash flood warnings frequent (polygon-based).

alert_types.definition: Critical fire weather ongoing or imminent; "Be extremely careful with open flames."
alert_types.action: No sparks (mowing, trailers, chains dragging), car fueled, go-bag by the door, check Genasys zone status, N95s staged. Peak months here: Oct, Jul.

alert_types.definition: "Critical fire weather conditions are possible but not imminent or occurring."
alert_types.action: Pre-stage: charge power banks, PSPS likely to follow — check PG&E PSPS 7-day forecast.

alert_types.definition: "Significant winter weather event including snow, ice, sleet or blowing snow... Travel will become difficult or impossible."
alert_types.action: Expect I-5 Grapevine/Tejon Pass closure + chain controls; stay put or leave early. Mostly Feb here.

alert_types.definition: "Conditions are favorable for a significant winter storm event."
alert_types.action: Fill tank, check chains/traction devices, stock 3+ days food/water, top off meds.

alert_types.definition: Wintry elements expected below warning criteria; "Be prepared for winter driving conditions."
alert_types.action: Most common alert here (30 in 5 yrs; Mar/Jan/Dec). Chains in car; check Caltrans CHIN 800-427-7623 before driving.

alert_types.definition: "Frequent gusts greater than or equal to 35 mph accompanied by falling and/or blowing snow, frequently reducing visibility to less than 1/4 mile for three hours or more."
alert_types.action: Do not travel. If stranded, stay with vehicle. Rare (1 in 5 yrs) but highest-impact.

alert_types.definition: "Sustained, strong winds with even stronger gusts are happening. Seek shelter."
alert_types.action: Downed lines / outages + fire spread risk; secure outdoor items; high-profile vehicles avoid I-5.

alert_types.definition: "Sustained, strong winds are possible. Secure loose outdoor items."
"Strong winds are occurring but are not so strong as to warrant a High Wind Warning."
"Conditions are favorable for flooding. It does not mean flooding will occur, but it is possible."
alert_types.action: Burn-scar debris flow risk after fires; avoid washes/low crossings.

alert_types.definition: "A flash flood is imminent or occurring... move immediately to high ground."
alert_types.action: County-wide polygon count (not place-specific). Never drive through water.

alert_types.definition: Extreme Heat Warning: "extremely dangerous heat conditions are expected or occurring." (NWS renamed Excessive Heat → Extreme Heat; both appear in history.)
alert_types.action: Jul/Aug. PSPS + heat = use cooling center (Kern opened the mountain park cooling center during the Sept 2020 PSPS).

gear_gap.baseline: American Red Cross minimum survival kit (3-day evac) — https://www.redcross.org/get-help/how-to-prepare-for-emergencies/survival-kit-supplies.html
baseline_items: Battery/hand-crank radio (NOAA Weather Radio if possible)

rows.verdict: GAP: 3 L is ~1 day. Keep 3 L in bag + 3 gal/person in house/car.
GAP: not on Bastion list. Cell + power fail together in PSPS/quake.
GAP: wildfire smoke — Red Flag zone CAZ597 had 19 warnings.
GAP: paper map of I-5/the mountain road/Lockwood Valley Rd egress; write Genasys zone on it.
PARTIAL: add written contact list + Genasys zone name.

rows.standard_says: Emergency blanket; extra clothing, hat, sturdy shoes; blankets/sleeping bags
rows.verdict: PARTIAL: at ~4,600 ft add hat/gloves + blanket for winter storms.

rows.standard_says: Whistle, work gloves, duct tape, plastic sheeting ("consider")
Ready.gov car: chains; sand/cat litter; ice scraper; jumper cables; flares; blanket; map; car charger; keep tank full
rows.verdict: CHECK: Caltrans R2 requires chains/traction devices on Grapevine; carry them all winter.

rows.standard_says: Ready.gov power outages: CO detectors; generators ≥20 ft from windows/doors
rows.verdict: GAP if running a generator during PSPS.

rows.standard_says: Fridge ~4 h, full freezer ~48 h; discard food above 40°F
rows.verdict: ADD thermometer to fridge/freezer for multi-day PSPS.

rows.standard_says: Secure heavy items; Drop, Cover, Hold On
rows.verdict: GAP: San Andreas 1857 Fort Tejon M~7.9 ruptured here; strap water heater, bookcases.

rows.standard_says: Cell phone with chargers; extra batteries
rows.verdict: OK; size for multi-day PSPS (Sept 2020 Lebec shutoff ran overnight).
